ENVIRONMENT  (--clearenv, then:)
  GEM_PATH         "/opt/gem store" /opt/gems-a    merge     gems-a
                     ← unknown: snug has no type for this name
                     ← declared path-list by gems-a, gems-b
                   /opt/gems-b                     merge     gems-b
                     ← unknown: snug has no type for this name
                     ← declared path-list by gems-a, gems-b
  HOME             /home/u                         (snug)
  LD_MY_LIBS       /opt/ld-gone                    merge     ldlibs
                     ← unknown: snug has no type for this name
                     ← declared path-list by ldlibs
                     ← LD_*: the dynamic loader reads this before main() in
                       every process (measured for LD_PRELOAD, LD_AUDIT and
                       LD_LIBRARY_PATH, glibc 2.43)
                     ← not granted
  LOGNAME          u                               (snug)
  MY_TOOL_ROOT     /opt/tool                       set       toolroot
                     ← unknown: snug has no type for this name
                     ← declared path by toolroot
  PATH             /usr/bin /bin /usr/sbin /sbin   (snug)    base
  PS1              🔒 snug:\w\$                     (snug)
  SHELL            /usr/bin/bash                   (snug)
  SNUG             1                               (snug)
  SNUG_PROFILES    @home,@sys,@target-rw,gems-a,gems-b,ldlibs,toolroot (snug)
  SNUG_TARGET      /home/u/proj/sub                (snug)
  TMPDIR           /tmp                            (snug)
  USER             u                               (snug)
  XDG_CACHE_HOME   /home/u/.cache                  set       @home
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME  /home/u/.config                 set       @home
  XDG_DATA_HOME    /home/u/.local/share            set       @home
  XDG_STATE_HOME   /home/u/.local/state            set       @home
  PWD              /home/u/proj/sub                (bwrap)   --chdir
                     ← bwrap sets this from --chdir; snug does not
